name: Should kitchen backsplash tile be installed before or after countertops?

mainEntity.name: Should kitchen backsplash tile be installed before or after countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: A kitchen backsplash is installed after your new countertops and upper cabinets are fully set in place. Installing counters first ensures the tile rests directly on a stable, level surface, preventing awkward gaps or uneven grout lines. As an owner-operated general contractor handling full kitchen renovations, Abraham Becerra schedules tile installation near the final stages of the remodel, right before final trim and touch-up interior painting. Installing earlier risks tile damage when heavy stone or quartz slabs are set. If you are keeping existing counters, we inspect the joint line to address any movement or settling before laying the first row of tile.
acceptedAnswer.description: Backsplash tile should always be installed after countertops and cabinets are in place to ensure a tight, level fit without risk of damage from heavy slab installations.
